title: After 2 months,  peeling off the bathtub floor
text: After 2 months,  peeling off the bathtub floor. I'm glad I waited a couple months before I submitted my review. The non slip paw prints were very easy to apply to the surface of the tub. They worked very well. I was not slipping anymore. However after the 2nd month. The paw prints started to peel off. The bottom layer is still stuck but the top layer is peeling off 1 by 1.
